text:
Ana L.: Quick preflight — greenroom dry run in 40m. can ops confirm recording + captions config?
Ryan O.: Yep, we're set on Zoom side. Cloud recording, separate audio, auto-transcript. will also kick a local backup.
Mike G.: Registration page copy tweak: current CTA 'Register' is meh. propose: 'Join live to see our latency + cost benchmark demo + AMA' — shorter, benefit-first.
Sarah P.: Slides reminder: speakers to drop final decks in the shared folder by EOD. link: https://drive.redwood.example/s/webinar-decks
Pia (Legal): Quick flag — avoid customer-facing screenshots unless you have written consent. if customers appear, blur or get sign-off.
Ryan O.: Zoom settings I'm toggling now (ops checklist):
```
Cloud recording: ON (separate files)
Record active speaker + gallery: ON
Audio transcript: AUTO
Alternative host local backup: ENABLED
Cloud -> S3 export: ENABLED (bucket: redwood-webinar-exports)
Retention: 90d
```
Ryan O.: Also enabling cloud caption track export (.vtt/.srt) to S3 so editing team can pull quickly.
Ana L.: Great. Mike — if we change CTA copy, pls update the reg page CTAs and the confirmation email subject line.
Mike G.: On it. I'll push a small copy update and AB test subject lines: a) "You're in — webinar replay and benchmarks" b) "Live demo: latency & cost deep dive". sending variants in 10m.
Sarah P.: Recording owner question: who owns raw file trim + 2-min highlight clip? Mike?
Mike G.: I can own edits + captions burn-in for social clips. need raw by +3h after event.
Ryan O.: S3 export will push raw + transcript automatically; I'll post the exact S3 path when done. Ops backup command for local copy (for on-call):
```bash
rsync -avz host:/var/tmp/zoom_backup/ /mnt/ops/webinar-backups/2026-03-23/
```
Ryan O.: I'll also trigger a deploy of the low-res stream to our CDN for live embed fallback.
Ana L.: Post-event follow-up plan (short):
- T+15m: 'Thanks — replay available' email with CTA to trial credit
- T+24h: highlight clip + TL;DR notes + benchmark snapshot image
- T+72h: targeted nurture (benchmarks track -> sales SDR)
Mike G.: For HubSpot routing: create list 'webinar_2026_03_benchmarks'. map properties: lead_source=webinar_2026_march, interest=benchmarks. can ops attach utm params on confirmation redirect?
Ryan O.: yes — we append ?utm_source=webinar2026&utm_campaign=benchmarks to replay redirect. HubSpot webhook will ingest and dedupe.
Pia (Legal): Also ensure replay email includes privacy blurb + opt-out for follow-ups.
Ana L.: Owners recap: Slides -> Sarah, Host/moderation -> Ana, Ops/recording -> Ryan, Clips + HubSpot cadence -> Mike, Legal sign-off -> Pia.
zoom-bot: Recording started (cloud) — 3344444348
Ryan O.: Noted. I'll message when S3 export completes and post the raw file path. :white_check_mark:
Ana L.: Thanks team — this is the last preflight. See you in the greenroom in 40. :rocket:
